messages:
alicia: Heads up — I found customer PII in an eval artifact. Repro'd on the new model bring-up runner when the job OOM'd and postprocessing didn't run.

alicia: log snippet:
```
ERROR 2026-04-02 15:02:10 write_artifact: /mnt/evals/1873/prompt_42.json
{"prompt":"Please summarize this customer's email: user@example.com ..."}
```

ben-ml: Ack. Can you paste exact repro steps?

alicia: Sure. Steps:
1) checkout `onboard/new-model-quant`
2) run `./scripts/eval-runner --config ci/onboard.yaml --quiet`
3) let it hit mem limit (we saw exit code 137)
Postprocessing hook didn't run, so `redact-artifacts` never executed.

chris-sre: Any idea which customers / envs are affected? Private or hosted?

alicia: Private onboarding job for a partner model (private repo). Artifacts landed in ci-storage with default ACLs for the runner service account.

eva-privacy: Oof. Were we running redaction in the agent or as a separate CI step? We should always assume artifacts can be read by service accounts.

alicia: It's supposed to run as a post-job step: `ci/onboard.yaml` -> `- run: redact-artifacts`. But because the runner process got SIGKILL, the step never executed.

mike-eval: I can repro locally; quick patch idea: run redaction inside a shutdown trap or a separate watchdog process that flushes pending artifacts.

ben-ml: +1. Also we should fail closed: if redaction can't be guaranteed, don't upload raw artifacts. That is, upload to a quarantined bucket with no public ACLs, then atomically move after redaction.

devops-bot: CI: job 58234 finished with status FAILURE. Artifact `s3://ci-storage/evals/1873/prompt_42.json` uploaded.

chris-sre: Immediate mitigations?

alicia: 1) Revoke read permissions for `ci-storage/evals/1873` (done). 2) Run purge for suspect artifacts: `evalctl purge --path s3://ci-storage/evals/1873 --confirm` (starting now). 3) Rotate service account tokens used by runner.

eva-privacy: Also add a policy to block uploads of JSON/text artifacts containing email-like regex until redaction passes. Could be a quick lambda.

ben-ml: I've opened a PR with changes to `onboard.yaml` to move redaction into an always-run container and to write raw outputs to a sealed bucket. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4982

ben-ml: patch snippet:
```
+ postprocessing:
+   image: redwood/redact:stable
+   when: always
+   command: ["/bin/redact", "--input", "/artifacts", "--output", "/sealed"]
```

mike-eval: I'll add an integration test to the eval-harness CI that intentionally kills the runner (SIGKILL) and verifies no plaintext artifacts are reachable.

alicia: OK. Action items:
- ben-ml: land PR + rollback plan (ETA 2h)
- mike-eval: add CI test (ETA EOD)
- chris-sre: confirm purge & token rotation done (ETA 1h)
- eva-privacy: draft customer notification if purge incomplete (ETA 3h)

alicia: I'll follow up in #incidents if anything needs escalation. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
